corrections.assessment: Both records are letters from William Hopkins to Darwin. Hopkins's 975 explicitly revisits Darwin's geometrico-geological problem, but it answers a missing Darwin question/data letter; 835 is an earlier Hopkins answer to an earlier missing Darwin communication, not the incoming antecedent of 975.

evidence.quote: The above diagram contains the solution of the problem which I received from you some time ago
Your letter reached me just as I was leaving Cambridge

corrections.assessment: 978 is another Hopkins-to-Darwin response to a missing Darwin datum. 'Yesterday' identifies the timing of Darwin's unlocated communication, not a Hopkins incoming prompt in 975; the shared problem establishes continuity only.

evidence.quote: The additional datum you sent to me yesterday is of no material service in your problem
